text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She successfully reached 9,000 followers. 
What's more, her current fans are people 
who chose to follow the real Mejiro 
Palmer, without her having to put on an 
honor student act.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While feeling both the joys and hardships 
of living freely, Mejiro Palmer regains 
the childlike innocence of living just as 
she feels.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next target is the Hakodate Kinen. 
Mejiro Palmer's new step forward was set 
for the GIII held in summer Hokkaido.
